periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with the vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the geometric mass concentrated below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shaped posterior margin with a relatively flat profile across the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Estimated at 30% of the visible longitudinal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance across the white cranial crown approximately equal to 1.5 times the width of an individual ear.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct creamy-yellowish discoloration visible in the white pelage across the mid and posterior dorsal regions.
